title: Native Sessions journal and provider pin
alt: Events & Sessions persists a run-bound Sessions provider pin and ordered event journal with reconnectable cursors. A separate Knowledge receipt relay appends project facts without creating session events or changing provider pins.

participants.label:
Events & Sessions

participants.subLabel: Journal, project facts, run pin, inbox

steps.label: POST /internal/sessions/{sessionId}
Caller uses GUID sub and one active project/run grant. Resolve an allowed provider and persist its exact run pin; mismatches fail closed.
Persist immutable project/run provider pin and session
Commit; return SessionRecord
201 Created
POST /internal/sessions/{sessionId}/events
Verify run pin; reject PolicyEvaluation without Core provenance; atomically write event, refs, sequence, and outbox
Commit durable event
201 new event; 200 identical retry
GET /internal/projects/{projectId}/runs/{runId}/events[/live]
Read run-ordered events after cursor; poll for live delivery
Rows retain session identity
Page or NDJSON: event + opaque nextCursor
Reconnect with nextCursor unchanged
Project facts are separate from session/run events; they never create sessions or change provider pins.
POST /internal/project-facts/accepted-effects: receipt ID, versions, existing same-actor bearer(s)
GET receipt from fixed configured HTTPS origin; redirects disabled
No-store receipt; original actor/bounds, no purpose, current effective WriteProjects
Events rechecks issuer, subject, bounds, purpose, and fresh effective WriteProjects.
One transaction: append receipt-derived project fact, sequence, inbox dedupe, and durable ack
Return persisted receipt-bound ack; Knowledge validates it before outbox ack
Delivery failure stays PENDING; retry needs fresh same-actor bearer(s). No background worker or token acquisition.
